mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLATFORM (platform_id, category_id, platform_name, deposit_name, settlement_cycle, settlement_trigger_type, settlement_offset_day, settlement_offset_unit, settlement_day_of_week, settlement_day_of_month) VALUES (#{platformId}, #{categoryId}, #{platformName}, #{depositName}, #{settlementCycle}, #{settlementTriggerType}, #{settlementOffsetDay}, #{settlementOffsetUnit}, #{settlementDayOfWeek}, #{settlementDayOfMonth})
mapper.select: SELECT platform_id, category_id, platform_name, deposit_name, settlement_cycle, settlement_trigger_type, settlement_offset_day, settlement_offset_unit, settlement_day_of_week, settlement_day_of_month FROM PLATFORM WHERE platform_id = #{platformId}

SELECT platform_id, category_id, platform_name, deposit_name, settlement_cycle, settlement_trigger_type, settlement_offset_day, settlement_offset_unit, settlement_day_of_week, settlement_day_of_month FROM PLATFORM
mapper.update: UPDATE PLATFORM SET category_id = #{categoryId}, platform_name = #{platformName}, deposit_name = #{depositName}, settlement_cycle = #{settlementCycle}, settlement_trigger_type = #{settlementTriggerType}, settlement_offset_day = #{settlementOffsetDay}, settlement_offset_unit = #{settlementOffsetUnit}, settlement_day_of_week = #{settlementDayOfWeek}, settlement_day_of_month = #{settlementDayOfMonth} WHERE platform_id = #{platformId}
